personality_one_liner: An immersive, cinematic, and deeply intellectual digital library that feels like wandering through a timeless, curated archive.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous, editorial breathing room. Allow typographic hierarchy to stand out without boxing content into rigid cards unless necessary. Avoid cramped padding.

do's: Use subtle blur on the bottom tab bar to let book covers glide underneath.
Use glass headers for the 18+ After Dark section to enhance the moody cinematic feel.
Apply glass effect to the reading controls bottom sheet to maintain reading context behind it.
dont's: Do not apply glass to actual book covers or reading pages.
Avoid heavy blur that reduces readability of editorial text.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Hero 3D Bookshelf discovery and curated collections.

states.empty: Elegant typography indicating no books found, with an exploration CTA.
states.error: Message 'The archive is temporarily closed' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Top features a horizontal Reanimated ScrollView representing the 3D bookshelf. Spines are visible by default. Selecting a spine uses shared element transition or reanimated transforms (rotateY to 0, scale up) to show the cover while dimming/shifting neighbors sideways. Below the hero: 'Featured', 'Mizo Heritage' and 'Explore by Category' horizontal lists with generous editorial spacing.

screens.name: BookDetail
screens.purpose: Displays rich book metadata and the primary 'Read Online' CTA.

states.loading: Spinner centered on a warm surface background.
states.error: Could not retrieve manuscript details. Retry.

screens.layout: Full-screen or high bottom sheet. Large book cover at the top, followed by editorial layout for Title (Playfair Display), Author, Year, and Description. Availability label (READ ONLINE / BORROW) is prominent. A sticky 'Read Online' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: UnifiedSearch
screens.purpose: A powerful academic and literary search across multiple sources.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty vintage shelf with 'No volumes found.'
states.error: Error querying the digital libraries. Retry.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at top. Horizontal scrollable tabs or pills for sources (Open Library, Gutenberg, DOAB). Filter row for Category, Language, Year, Availability. Results support toggleable Grid/List/Bookshelf views.

screens.name: AfterDark18Plus
screens.purpose: Age-gated, visually distinct section for mature content.
screens.layout: Initial screen: Full-bleed moody library background, age confirmation checkbox, and a gold CTA. Upon entry: App theme inverses to Dark mode (#171717 background) seamlessly. Typography remains Playfair Display but glows slightly against the dark canvas.

screens.name: OnlineReader
screens.purpose: Distraction-free consumption interface with high customization.
screens.layout: Content is king. Hidden navigation by default. Tapping the center reveals a glassmorphic top header (Back, Bookmark) and a bottom sheet for customization (Theme: Warm, Cream, Sepia, Dark; Fonts: Serif/Sans/Dyslexia; Size slider 14-32; Margins).

screens.name: ProfileLibrary
screens.purpose: User's personal archive of saved and history books.

states.empty: Your shelf is empty. Start exploring.

screens.layout: Clean editorial list or grid of saved books. Minimalist tabs for 'Saved', 'History', 'Bookmarks'.

hero_vintage_stack.alt: A vintage stack of classic literature books

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color palette: Main background #F3F0E9, Text #202020, Accent #A58A58, Shelf #E8E4DC. The 'After Dark 18+' section MUST override the global theme to use the Dark background #171717.
For the Dark Theme support across the app, invert the surfaces to dark grays/blacks (#171717 for background, #232323 for cards) but keep the Accent Gold (#A58A58) and ensure text is #F3F0E9.
Typography must enforce 'Playfair Display' for headings, titles, and book titles. Use 'DM Sans' for functional UI, metadata, and buttons.

The 3D Bookshelf Hero is critical. Use react-native-reanimated to create a horizontal scroll where items transform (rotateY and scale). The inactive books look like spines. When active/tapped, they rotate flat to reveal the cover.

Reader UI must be distraction-free. Controls (Theme toggles, Font pickers, Margin sliders) should be housed in a @gorhom/bottom-sheet that is only summoned when the user taps the center of the reading screen.
Use standard semantic availability labels with distinct muted/success/warning styling: READ ONLINE, READ AT SOURCE, BORROW TO READ, METADATA ONLY.
Mizo Heritage Library should feel culturally distinct. Consider adding subtle border treatments or a dedicated header typography style to elevate its presence.

Ensure all interactive text/icons over the 'After Dark' moody background image utilize the mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 1 vertical gradient to surfaceInverse) to guarantee contrast.
